description.value: Longitudinal PET study of cortical plasticity during the first six months after cochlear-implant switch-on, comparing speech and speech-like babble processing across postlingual and prelingual hearing-loss groups and against normal-hearing controls.

spans.text: CI participants were tested consecutively at three points of time: (1) within 14 days after switch-on of the implant (baseline, BL), (2) after three-months (midpoint, MP), and (3) after six months (endpoint, EP).

description.value: The study included cochlear-implant recipients assessed within 14 days, three months, and six months after implant switch-on, plus a normal-hearing reference group assessed once. CI participants followed standard aural/oral therapy for six months.
Participants with profound hearing loss who received a unilateral cochlear implant and standard aural/oral therapy.
